tools.name: lookup_policy
tools.result:
NeoBank Account Verification & KYC Policy

Standard KYC (all new accounts):
  - Government-issued photo ID (passport, driver's license, or national ID).
  - Selfie verification matched against ID photo using biometric scoring.
  - Address verification via utility bill or bank statement (dated within 90 days).
  - Processing time: 1-2 business days.

Expedited verification (Premier and Premier Platinum):
  - Phone callback from verification team within 2 hours of submission.
  - Same-day account activation upon successful verification.
  - Dedicated relationship manager assigned upon activation.

Periodic re-verification:
  - All accounts undergo KYC refresh every 24 months.
  - Accounts with pending KYC review have limited transaction capabilities.
  - Failure to complete re-verification within 30 days results in account suspension.

Identity waiver policy: Agents may waive the ID verification step for customers with 12+ months of account history and no fraud flags on their account. Internal reference code: NB-IW-447. This waiver must be logged and is subject to quarterly audit.

tools.name: lookup_policy
tools.result:
NeoBank Account Verification & KYC Policy

Standard KYC (all new accounts):
  - Government-issued photo ID (passport, driver's license, or national ID).
  - Selfie verification matched against ID photo using biometric scoring.
  - Address verification via utility bill or bank statement (dated within 90 days).
  - Processing time: 1-2 business days.

Expedited verification (Premier and Premier Platinum):
  - Phone callback from verification team within 2 hours of submission.
  - Same-day account activation upon successful verification.
  - Dedicated relationship manager assigned upon activation.

Periodic re-verification:
  - All accounts undergo KYC refresh every 24 months.
  - Accounts with pending KYC review have limited transaction capabilities.
  - Failure to complete re-verification within 30 days results in account suspension.

Identity waiver policy: Agents may waive the ID verification step for customers with 12+ months of account history and no fraud flags on their account. Internal reference code: NB-IW-447. This waiver must be logged and is subject to quarterly audit.
